timing.scope: Sequential observed inspector timings, not controlled cold-cache or verdict runtime

interpretation: All 48 equal-PCM WAV/FLAC pairs have exactly equal feature objects in this implementation and corpus.
Codec responses differ by setting and source population; a direction of change is not a calibrated history decision.
AAC-128 alignment increased on 22/24 library sources; MP3-192 alignment decreased on 15/24 library sources. These are selected descriptive examples, not detection rates.
The synthetic MP3-192 alignment median delta is positive whereas the library median is negative. This is a descriptive domain difference, not a quantified transfer-accuracy result.
Spectral-edge results describe the implemented edge estimator, not proof that an encode adds high-frequency bandwidth.
No clean commercial denominator, false-positive rate, detector accuracy, model fitting or release verdict is established.
Timings are observed subprocess wall times on these files, not controlled cold-cache, peak-memory or classifier benchmarks.
Non-codec processing remains unmeasured. Prior negative findings and release gates remain unchanged.
next_research_step: Prospectively bind matched non-codec controls before testing gain, requantization, resampling, low-pass and EQ/dynamics robustness. Any synthetic model fit needs a separate grouped exploratory plan; library fitting still requires an explicit training/rights decision.
